fact: A High Commission for Digitalisation director said the National Digital Services Center, inaugurated on Independence Day 2026, provides cloud services to public bodies to host their data in virtual data centres, so ministries no longer need their own data centres.
title: البوابة الوطنية للخدمات الرقمية تعزز التحول الرقمي وتحسن جودة الخدمات العمومية
